reviews.text: Not so good results. I’ve been using this app for the past 4 years! At first the first 2 years was good but after that everything started to be unreliable! The period tracker does not track the way it needs to be tracking, even if I update my information it’s not even 60% right! I like it but I’m ready for a new change!
Best app so far!. I have tried many tracking apps, most of them sucked you i had to pay to get the things i wanted. This is a lifesaver

Worst period tracker I’ve used. I’ve literally never written an app review before but the frustration of using this app has pushed me to finally do so. The app is terrible at predicting when your period actually starts unlike other period trackers I’ve used. It always ends up tricking me into thinking that my period is late which has given me a lot of anxiety over the past few years that I’ve used it. Speaking of, I don’t think they’ve updated the look or functionality in the whole time I’ve used it. Editing the timing of your period is frustrating and clunky. Shouldn’t it just know that you’ve started your cycle when you enter the corresponding bleeding emoji? I can see how some people might use it to track unnatural flow or spotting but I guess it’s just not for me. I also think the system of using emojis is kind of dumb and childish. Hopefully they update it at some point but for now, I’ll be looking for another period trackers that’s more convenient to use.

period tracker stopped working. The period tracker won’t save the dates I pick for my period. It only highlights what the app predicted. Every time I update a day with my flow it says “this is not when we predicted your period to start. Please update on calander.” But when I try to do that, the red circles don’t save on the dates I put. This has been my only issue and it is at least a 2 month old issue.

Used to work great. The app used to work great, but over the last few months the tracking feature has been inaccurate and difficult to adjust. I’m strongly considering switching to a different period tracker. Another thing, the developers of the app suggest that folks who leave negative reviews here use the “contact support” button on the account page but when I tried to do that the button straight up didn’t work.

Used to be my fav period tracker app. I’ve been trying to enjoy this app but recently they updated it to even if you’re not on your period it marks that you are on your period, even after saying you aren’t. I’m not a fan anymore. If you’re seriously trying to track your period and ovulation periods , I wouldn’t recommend this app.

Used to be amazing. I have been using this app for years and it was amazing but I started realizing that any time i went to log a period it would ask me “is this your first day?” even if I was already on day 3. It annoyed me a bit but what really made me delete the app was the fact that I got a new phone and when I went to launch the app it would open but have a blue screen with a spinning circle. I thought if I deleted it and reinstalled it would fix it. It did… Until I realized it erased all of my past data and there’s no log back in feature. I guess I’m going to have to find a new app :/
Used to work great. Half the time I can’t open the app, it just queues. It used to send notifications for my period and doesn’t anymore

reviews.text:
Meh…. Hey there, I am the one who emailed you about the ad-like pop-up appearing every time I log my period. This message is telling me if I am a newcomer, but I am not, I have been using Spot On since 2024!

I know it is hard to wait that long for you to fix this issue, but I am good at waiting patiently for future updates/bug fixes. If this pop-up is still there when I try to log my period in your next update, I will either send you another letter or write/edit another review.

I also have a suggestion that should add several more languages such as French, Korean (my phone’s language is set in this language), Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, and Japanese.

Used to work. The app worked great until about a month or two ago. Now, everyday shows up red like I’m on my menstruating everyday. This is obviously not helpful for tracking purposes. I submitted a help ticket to the developers and they assured me the glitch would be fixed. No change. If you need a reliable track app don’t use this one.

Used to be five stars. This app has gotten so buggy. Thank you for fixing the bazillion notifications that would occur at one time. But now I’m getting prompts about when my period started while I’m ON my period and have already gone through the trouble of editing my period as the app has asked vs just choosing bleeding for the day. Also, please give us back a customizable emoji or other things to track. I need to track other related things like clotting for example. You used to let us choose one custom emoji and tracking item. I would appreciate that option again. I do love how you don’t go overboard in expectations like having a notes section or too many things to pick from. That’s why even though I really want more, just one emoji again would be enough. When things are overwhelming like with most apps and there’s so much to fill out, I just avoid using them. That’s one reason I love love love your app and have used it since it came out. Thank you for making and maintaining it.

Used to be good, now absolutely buggin. My predictions and my past logs are all messed up and wrong after a fairly recent update. Theres no way to fix it or reset it or anything. Guess I'll just track it in my planner 🤷‍♀️

I’m confused. I used this app for many many years and it was great, lots of features and reasonably accurate predictions. Around 2020ish they did a big overhaul and removed most features and deleted user data. I was upset to have lost so many years of tracking but figured as long as I can put dots on the calendar to record my periods it’s still worth using. Multiple updates since then have deleted my data again. I don’t understand why updates delete user data and why they can’t fix it. 

Lately when I try to edit my periods nothing happens. I edit, press the save button, and the dots I made disappear. Sometimes I can find my period dates by clicking each day to see “cycle day” but now it will just delete the cycle when I close the app. No matter how many times I edit my period it just deletes my information and logs my period on whatever days it wants. I’ve turned off period prediction but it still does this. 

All I want is an app that lets me put red dots on a calendar. I don’t understand why they can’t make this app functional.

Love it but notifications don’t work. Glad to have a period tracker that doesn’t sell my data, but since the last update, I only get notifications when I open the app. And then, I get a handful at a time that seemed like they are out of date. If you are wondering whether to download this app, you should do it. Just know that you might not be getting notifications correctly until the next update.

Used to be good. This app used to be reliable. But lately, even though I have notifications on, it still will not remind me to take my pill. I’ve tried toggling notifications on and off, changing the time, etc. and still it will not notify me unless I open up the app and then all of a sudden the notifications all pop up. Not reliable.

not giving reminders anymore. this app has been very helpful for me to remember to take my birth control, but randomly i would say in the last few or so weeks it doesn’t give me a reminder to take it anymore . and when i open the app it spams me with like 10 notifications to take it and reminders about my period. i really hope they fix that because i don’t want to lose all my data

Birth Control Reminders Don’t Work. I got this app when my PP provider recommended it to me as a birth control reminder, since I have to take it the same time every day. The alarm has never once worked. I’ve tried setting it to different times, making sure notifications are allowed.. nothing. I only ever get a pop-up notification when I enter the app that’s just a pill emoji. It works fine as a tracker and log, just don’t use it for alarms/notifications, which was the whole reason I got this app to begin with.

Glitches with recent update. This app worked great until the most recent update. I can no longer adjust my period dates on the calendar, as the “save” button has disappeared, so all of my dates are now off with no way to correct/edit them. The link to app support goes to a Page Not Found with no redirect.

notifications stopped working. after updating the app, i no longer receive my scheduled notifications. however every time i manually open the app, it spams me with 7 notifications all at once displaying every possible alert (period coming, period starting, fertile day coming, pill reminder, etc). not sure how to fix this since deleting the app will delete all my data. it’s not the biggest issue since i remember to take my pill daily but it’s definitely an inconvenience

What happened???. This app used to be amazing! I haven’t been on in a couple days and this morning I opened it and the app’s a mess! Constant banner notifications at the top of the screen, days marked ‘none’ suddenly all highlighted red when before only period days were highlighted red. It’s impossible to tell which days were period days without opening the menu for each individual day. It keeps bouncing around menus I didn’t even tell it to open! What is going on???

Used to work great. This used to be a nice functional app. Most days, I’d record my flow as “none” to “heavy.” This morning I opened my app and saw that the calendar display had changed to display red dots on almost ALL my days. Whenever I entered my flow as “none,” the calendar now displays a big red dot as if I’d entered it as “heavy.” The calendar is now useless, unless I manually go through and remove my “none” entry for most of the days. 

I think I’ll go back to using a paper calendar.

All Red Now. After recent update it keeps giving me like 9 notifications over and over when I open the app. But most importantly, literally all my tracked days became red. So it’s pointless now that I can’t go back know when I got my period last… I’ve only had the app for 2.5 months.

Deleted all my data. I love(d) this period tracker, but I opened it this morning and while it seemed a little buggy, I thought it was normal. Come to find that once I rechecked the account, all my tracking and account data was gone and I’m having to start from scratch. This is extremely frustrating to deal with, especially as a woman who needs a reliable pill and period tracker.
Lost all data. Lost all data on new update…it used to be a good app

All data deleted. I wish that there was a warning that all of my data would be deleted after I updated to the most recent version. The app is no longer useful to me as I no longer have access to the three years’ worth of vital information related to my period. I will be deleting the app.

Not Spot On. I thought this was a safer alternative to tracking my period through Apple. But it tells me my period should be earlier than it actually is, a week or more earlier. Gives me a heart attack I’m pregnant!Very disappointing since this app is built by Planned Parenthood.
So disappointed. All my data from months and months of me logging my period is GONE!!! There is no way to log into your account I have to start all over so will no longer use this app!

Very cool. We love losing all our data after an update, we definitely weren't actively using that information for important medical information. I didn't swap devices or delete the app ever, so surely it wouldn't just all vanish into the void like the FAQs implied, if not outright stated.

Also, can we get a toggle for the period prediction circles and the annoying opening popup? The predictions are never accurate for me, the affirmations are irritating coming from randos, and theyre both just visual clutter in an app I use to put dots and emojis on a calendar. The "irregular" option worked great, so I suppose thats why it got removed.

Used to be SPOT ON. As many others have said, this app was great BEFORE the update. It was actually spot on every time. I had 3 years of data and knew exactly when my period was starting. Now, it predicts my period wrong and much earlier than it starts. I’m only using this app now to log my period, but other than that it’s spot-less. If the developers could retrieve the data I would be very happy but as of now I actually hate this app. I’ll never forget how devastated I was when all the data was lost.
Waste. opened one day and all my data is gone

Mostly frustrating... I like that it has the option to add that birth control was started or stopped but…. I seriously need an option for writing notes…. It seems like the main function of the app is to track if you add birth control or remove it…. There’s more to female health than birth control…. Super super frustrating that there aren’t options for personalization of what you want to keep track of. Instead it’s pushing you to go to the planned parenthood website or again…get on birth control…. If all that wasn’t enough…. The notifications of “Have you gotten your period yet?” On your screen….not a good mix if you are a bit sensitive and hormonal…. 
Deleted the app pretty quick after downloading it….

terrible since update. It was great before the update, now, as others have said, it’s nearly useless. First, I lost three years of data. Now I have seven months of data showing my cycle, but every single month it predicts a cycle that is way shorter than mine has ever been. I have to manually reset my cycle length every. month. I trust PP and want to use this app, but its main feature cycle prediction is completely broken.

Chat bot. At first I thought this app would be fine, but it changed my mind when I talked to the chat bot! 
 I kept talking to it and saying things not related to intimacy? but it kept bringing it up and trying to educate me on it, while not answering the questions I was asking. I'm not ready to talk about intimacy yet, but it was really annoying! Please fix, i'm now deleting the app.

All Data Lost. I’ve been using this app for a couple years to try to figure out some health issues with my obgyn by tracking my cycle. The app kept crashing recently so I updated it. All of my data I had tracked was lost and customer service said it cannot be recovered since they don’t have an option to have an account to save it to. Pick a different app.

They ruined it. This app was AWESOME back in the day, but they did some major overhauls and absolutely ruined it. The way it averages cycle length makes no sense, my cycles have been 29-31 days and it says my cycle length is 22 days and predicts fertility and periods off of that. Obviously my period came later than that, but I can’t say “didn’t start on this day”, I can only say “did start”, so it just keeps telling me I’m on my period even if I log that I’m not bleeding. My period started on the 30th, so I tried to edit my period. It doesn’t let me scroll to the next month though, so now all my predictions are based on a period 2 days long stone that’s all I can select as “period days” until the 1st. You had such a great app back in 2019, why did you ruin it? Scrap your updates, bring back the good version.

Great app that I can trust. I love this app to replace my old one but I do miss the extra customization and tons of moods, emotions, body, choices etc (it also had levels of pain/emotion/etc) my old one had and with a big calendar and a part to jot notes down daily. wish this had more but it's still great

BC feature is great but... This app is struggling to log my birth control. It gives a prediction of when my period will come but then when I try to log my period over my prediction, my period doesn’t get logged on the app. I’m deleting it.

reviews.text: Used to be great, gets less so over time. I miss the ability to have your own emoji with symptoms, which hasn’t been a thing on this app for a long time, but is sorely missed. I also don’t like that I can’t delete emoji I am never going to use. The calendar is no longer useful, it used to say what day of your cycle you are on if you click the day, now you can only add. Not useful if you are looking at a glance. It is less useful if you have an irregular period, because sometimes it doesn’t bother giving a “fertile window”. If I could add cervical mucus tracking, that would be more useful, if that is what the app is going for, rather than guessing.

Fix Predictions + Add Text?. Spot on has been great and I would trust PP with my data before any other developer! 

The only issues I have with the app is that the predictor function is days off always and never seems to recalibrate. As a design note, I also thing it would be helpful to have a journal like function on the calendar where in addition to logging symptoms people could write in about their day/info if they so choose.

reviews.text: New update erases data. Latest app update erases all user data. I emailed the technical support team and they know the update erases your data, but they put nothing in place to save your data nor does it warn you to back it up before updating.

WAS my favorite.. The new update provides a terrible user experience. 

The old version didn’t have a pretty dashboard and forced you to navigate through many buttons to input your birth control status, moods, events, etc. This was a nuisance. However it could be overlooked BECAUSE of the many features it had. Such as including or skipping the placebo pills, accurate predictions, and just more useful features.

This new update managed to make a decent dashboard with quick one-touch updates for your BC status, moods, etc. BUT it removed everything else. Which is, in my opinion, a downgrade.

Removing those features rendered the app useless to me and now I must find another app. I hope that they can find a happy middle ground for what the users want and what they’re trying to accomplish with this new update. Once that happens, I’ll get back on here. ♥️

Utterly useless. This app has ONE main job. Tracking periods and cycles. And it fails miserably because they have this “period prediction” indicator that somehow overrides the actual input dates of your flow. For example, my cycle is slightly inconsistent and it was late in June (normally supposed to be at beginning of the month but came at the last week). However, this useless and inaccurate predictor’s dates state that my “last period” started Jun 30 (not the actual start date I put but is the prediction of when I was “supposed” to have had it)… so therefore my cycle average is also wildly off, saying it’s 28 days when I know for a FACT this isn’t true lol. And even if you toggle the predictor off, nothing about your cycle data changes. Going back to F.

App was great, now not so much. Prior to updating, the interface of the app was amazing. One of the biggest issues I have is that after updating my period predictions are off, I am no longer able to track birth control like I used to, and there’s no option to skip the placebos during my period week. I think the app is definitely more difficult to use now and majority of the features that made it special are gone.
nice app but.. Nice app but very very inaccurate

was great, now booty flakes. lost 4 years of tracking... app wont even open anymore. just a white screen. it was fine until they updated it... ive been waiting for a fix but nothing has come. will not utilize this app again. just gonna track it in my calendar smh.
WAS great. This app WAS great, but now with the update I lost my data and also certain features are gone or no longer user friendly. Disappointed. I will be switching to a different app.

Used to love then Lost data multiple times. I used to love this app, I found it helpful and user friendly but then my tracking data was erased 3 times!! which is not only a major disappointing but also a huge challenge for monitoring and tracking my health progress.

Lost all my data after updating. Love spot on for it’s super simple layout but I lost all my data after updating :( super sad about it

Mood body and activities tab. I wish they could add a feature where you could add your own emotions and actions instead of picking from their options because theirs are limited. I also wish they tracked what emotions you felt all through your period

Good. I like the app in general but I hate the fact that it doesn’t have an option to login or create an account when it’s downloaded.

DELETED 4 YEARS OF DATA - company will not respond!. I diligently tracked on this app for four years. One day I woke up and every single data point was GONE. Never to be seen again. reviews.text: Can’t track birth control?. I use this app to track my birth control and to remind me when to change my ring. It no longer sends reminders to change my ring, and it constantly says I’m on a fertile day even though I’ve been using my birth control perfectly. Data loss. I use to absolutely love this app but everytime I have to update it mysteriously looses all my previous data and won’t give me the option to attempt to recover. Gets frustrating when you’ve been keeping up with your data for a year and then your forced into an update and looses everything. This is the third time this has happened. Please fix this!!!!

⚠️ New update deleted years worth of data. I was having issues with an older version of the app’s ability to predict my cycle so I updated to the latest version (5.1.2). Unfortunately this deleted 3+ years of data that was not recorded anywhere else, and when I reached out to support they could not recover it. Although I liked a lot of features about this app (user friendly, discreet notifications, gender neutral ui), and it seems like the new update improved the ability to predict cycles, I feel like I can’t trust it to hold on to my information anymore :(
Best thing ever. Ok so I got my period September 12th and I didn’t get my period until January. I’m okay now but somehow the app knew the exact day I was gonna get my period. Absolute magic!🪄

the new update is the worst!!!!. it seems to have deleted all my data from the last 2 years, and now it doesn’t even remember it month by month. it doesn’t adjust predictions like it used to i honestly do not know why they changed things but i wish yall would go back

Randomly deleted all my info ???. I logged in one day and it erased the date I put my birth control implant in. And I scroll up and all of my period days are completely gone

Best, no gimmicks, period app. I am very impressed with this app. It is totally free, no ads, and they never try to make you pay for a subscription like a lot of the other apps do. With that being said, it is a little more bare bones than some of the other apps, but I like how simple it is. My only complaint is that since the last update I have been getting notifications to take my pill and then when I click it to open the app it says I have to come back later to log that I took the pill which is rather annoying.

Deleted 7 Years of Info!. I’m so furious! I’ve used this app for over 7 years and have logged things including several pregnancies, miscarriages, Plan B pill info and it helped track my cycle and ovulation down to the day! I open it last month after an update, and everything is GONE!! I’ve held onto it hoping that the information would be restored…still NOTHING!! This was the worst update ever done to this app and very important information has been deleted!

Broken update. Like many other reviewers, I’d been using this app for years and loved it until the latest update messed it up. My predictive dates are inaccurate and data is largely deleted/slow to load. Even inputting tracking information is slow, and logs down statuses on days I didn’t touch. Sad that now I need to find a new tracker app.

Updates delete data. App keeps updating and deleting all my data. Lost over a year worth of period tracking because of some update. I tried to start tracking again, logged in a month later, to see app did another update where last month’s period data also got deleted and the calendar had the previous week marked as period days even though I didn’t mark them. Works fine, great for privacy, but there’s better out there.. I like this app because it was created by planned parenthood. Because they're a well known reproductive health organization, I am less worried that my data will be shared or sold. 

Also, the user interface and branding is very gender neutral, and clinical. This is something I prefer. I’ve always hated when period apps send notifications with cheesy things like “you go girl!” or something similar. 

That being said, if you do turn on push notifications, I appreciate how discrete they are in their wording. For me personally,
I’m all for de-stigmatizing periods, and wouldn’t mind a less cryptic message. But, I’m in the minority there, so it was nice to see the thought that went into the notifications.

That being said, it is otherwise a pretty barebones app. Some period apps adapt to the length of the average cycle of one particular user, so they can be more accurate to the individual. Spot On always predicts your next period as 28 days after the first day of your most recent period. (I think it is possible to manually edit the average length of one’s cycle in the app, but if it is, this is pretty tedious to calculate/input) 

After Spot On routinely predicting that my period would arrive 3-7 days earlier than it actually did, I looked for a better alternative (Clue) and transferred the cycle data from one app to the other. I’ve been using both now, just to see the difference in the two, and Clue has been noticeably more accurate. And has most of the positive features listed above. The one concern i do have is privacy, Spot On still wins 100% in that regard. 

Also, Spot On is completely free as far as I can tell, and doesn’t bother you with pop-ups trying to sell you on a premium subscription. 

So all in all, it depends what you’re looking for. I would recommend this app to people who are pretty regular in their cycle, and just need some reminding, people who value privacy over other features, and people who hate pop-up ads.

reviews.text: Simple, informative & promising. It’s easy to create your login, navigate and have a good selection of symptoms etc. The interface is very adult, and clean. However, one crucial item I really enjoyed in other apps, that this one does not include, is the ability to make notes or jot down medication. If I were on antibiotics for example, I’d like to be able to note when I started and finished my medication and note any effects this had on my feminine health. It would also be great to be able to add more information in regard to my feminine health for future reference, like past appointments etc. Just a thought! For now I will continue to use two apps.

“Start a new pack” setting is messed up. I like this app, particularly bc I can track my pill pack and missed pills, but there’s one big issue. Once you choose a pack start say, you can’t change it if you got it wrong. I don’t understand who thought that was a good idea, but I don’t see what the purpose of that is.
